brand_identity.name: Ayojan Wale
brand_identity.theme: Indian, Festive, Premium, Warm, Modern, Trustworthy

heading.usage: All major headings. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large headings to look editorial.

body.usage: Body copy, button labels, small UI elements. Clean, modern contrast to the serif.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tighter leading-none text-royal-plum
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight text-royal-plum
scale.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-marigold

theming_strategy.default_base: Primary UI relies on Warm Ivory background, Royal Plum primary elements, and Marigold accents.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (E1 rules). Never cram content. Use margins of 24, 32, 40 on tailwind scale.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento Grid Mode A (Asymmetrical). Overlap elements slightly to break structural rigidity. Use 12-column foundation.
layout_and_spacing.photography: Spotlight treatment. Avoid perfectly square images. Use 'arch' cuts via border-radius (e.g., rounded-t-[40%] or rounded-t-full on specific aspect ratios) to evoke traditional Indian architectural aesthetics but in a modern way.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, warm shadows. Use shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(74,23,72,0.15)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D8A84E (Soft Gold) at 30% opacity to frame premium cards. Do not use generic gray borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, low opacity) over Royal Plum sections to remove digital flatness.

components.button_primary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-royal-plum text-warm-ivory font-sans font-medium hover:bg-deep-wine transition-all duration-300 shadow-md
components.button_secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 border border-soft-gold text-royal-plum font-sans font-medium hover:bg-soft-gold/10 transition-all
components.nav_bar: Fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-warm-ivory/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-soft-gold/20. STRICT RULE: No fully transparent headers.
components.cards_marketing: Use raw HTML/Tailwind (no Shadcn Card). bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-charcoal/5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked text. Wrap each line of H1 in <div className='overflow-hidden'>. Animate <motion.div> from y: '100%' to y: '0' with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and staggered delay.
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion whileInView. Fade up (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis library is MANDATORY for premium editorial feel.
motion.parallax: Use subtle y-axis translation on scroll for images within the Bento Grid.

page_sections.find_vendors_listing: Clean, highly usable marketplace layout. Filters on left (collapsible on mobile), grid on right. High functional clarity, using Warm Ivory base and Plum accents, avoiding heavy emotional hero elements.
page_sections.plan_my_event_wizard: Step-by-step form flow. Use customized Shadcn form components. Clean centered layout with a progress bar utilizing the 'tracing beam' concept in Soft Gold. Warm Ivory background.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (installed). Keep stroke width thin (1.25 or 1.5) for a premium feel.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Royal Plum and Deep Wine text passes WCAG AA on Warm Ivory.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS query for the Framer Motion reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write components using .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx (TypeScript is not used).
Install Framer Motion (npm i framer-motion), React Fast Marquee (npm i react-fast-marquee), and Lenis (npm i @studio-freight/lenis).
Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' fonts via Google Fonts in index.css.
Define the color palette as CSS variables in index.css (e.g. --royal-plum) and extend Tailwind theme to use them.
Do NOT use raw HTML `<select>` or native date pickers. Use Shadcn components for inputs in the 'Plan My Event' wizard.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn Card components for the marketing homepage sections; use custom divs with Tailwind to enable overlapping and asymmetry.
The Hero section must feature the masked line-by-line text reveal using Framer Motion.
Apply `data-testid` to buttons, links, and major section wrappers.
NEVER use generic placeholder images. Use the Unsplash URLs provided.
Use Lenis for smooth scroll wrap around the main layout.
Apply image architectural clipping via tailwind (e.g. rounded-t-full) to echo Indian archways.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic: no uniform boxes, simplistic gradients, or perfectly centered standard layouts.
Do not apply global `transition: all` to everything.
Create depth through overlapping z-indexes and soft ambient shadows.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds over headers where content scrolls underneath.
Micro-animations on buttons and cards are mandatory.
